_comment: C-source-led cheap variation frozen before recording or JavaScript comparison. It keeps the corrected level-30 and Conflict setup and changes only the hostile defender from a Stone Golem to a Goblin, exercising the same Nurse AD_HEAL monster-versus-monster arm against a different physical target. The two-turn endpoint is retained from the first-hit recipe as a short observation window; this recipe does not predict which monster attacks or whether the Goblin survives.
